basis.selection_reason: 011 执行与比较成功，使用该表已验证日期；优先 010 同题候选 / 共同兼容日，再按日期升序
basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: CAST(TRY_CAST(STAT_TIME_HOUR AS DATE) AS DATE) AS date_day

edits.new: CASE WHEN CONVERSION IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(CONVERSION AS TEXT)) IN ('', 'true', 'false') OR CONVERSION LIKE 'mock_%' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(CONVERSION AS INT) END AS conversions
CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN ROUND(spend / clicks, 2) ELSE 0 END AS calculated_cost_per_click
CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN ROUND((spend / impressions) * 1000, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_thousand_impressions
CASE WHEN CAST(REACH AS INT) > 0 THEN ROUND((spend / CAST(REACH AS DECIMAL(18, 3))) * 1000, 2) ELSE 0 END AS cost_per_thousand_reached
